scripts.dev: node init && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:web: node init && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run start:dev -w apps/backend
scripts.build: node init && npm run build:web && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:web: node init && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:backend: node init && npm run build -w apps/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:backend
